headline: FTC launches formal investigation into OpenAI, Anthropic over AI practices
body: The Federal Trade Commission has opened a probe into OpenAI and Anthropic alongside other AI giants, marking the first major regulatory scrutiny of leading generative AI developers. This investigation directly impacts healthcare organizations evaluating AI vendors for clinical workflows and EHR integration, as regulatory compliance now becomes a material risk factor in vendor selection. Healthcare systems must now factor potential FTC enforcement actions and compliance requirements into their AI technology roadmaps and contract negotiations. The probe signals that healthcare CIOs and consulting teams should prioritize vendors with transparent data governance, clear model training disclosures, and demonstrated commitment to addressing regulatory expectations around safety and data handling.
